title: Ukulala Okungaphezu Kwesikhathi
intro: Cabanga ngesikhathi lapho iqiniso lathuliswa khona futhi abakholwayo bezingelwa. Iqembu elincane lakhetha ukuhoxa esikhundleni sokuzinikela, lithola indawo yokukhosela ezindaweni ezingalindelekile - indawo eyayizoba yindawo yabo yokuphumula amakhulu eminyaka angenakubalwa. Lapho ekugcineni bevuka, umhlaba wawusushintshile nxazonke zabo. Bangobani laba bantu abalele?
clues: Umphakathi wethu wawufuna ukuba sikhulekele kanye nabo, kodwa senqaba.
Sabaleka edolobheni sifuna indawo yokuphephela kulabo ababephikisa izinkolelo zethu.
Umngane othembekile onemilenze emine wahlala emnyango wendawo yethu yokucasha.
U-Allah wasenza salala iminyaka engamakhulu amathathu nesishiyagalolunye.
Ekugcineni lapho sivuka, idolobha lethu elalishushiswa lalamukele ukholo.
